limitation: Documented block treatment/simultaneous adoption and beta API
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: An outcome panel with controls/treated rows and untreated/treated time blocks under simultaneous adoption.
scientific_qualification.output: Synthetic-DiD treatment contrast with method-specific uncertainty.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Block treatment layout, suitable donor/preperiod support and the method's outcome-model/design restrictions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Reject staggered adoption as direct input to the documented block interface. Pin beta API and define aggregation before preprocessing.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Reproduce a rank-one factor panel with a known common treatment effect; reject mixed adoption dates and inspect donor-weight concentration.

evidence.finding: Simultaneous/block adoption, estimator/variance usage and beta status.
